about: What the droids of Urbs say, in the story: as data/dialogue/droids.json has it for a maze - the same three kinds of droid, in the same models and voices, the same lines, replies, checks, bribes, moods, barks and 'threatened' - but about the city: the way to Summa, its tallest tower, where {exit_far} and {exit_way} point; and the stores and banks being robbed, by the player. 'inhabitants' is how many droids are about the player at once, and 'crowd' has them be a crowd: one left far behind, out of sight, turns up again nearer by as another, wherever the player cannot see, so the streets are as busy wherever they go. A character's 'in_pairs' is the share of its kind that walk about in twos, one keeping beside the other: talk one round, or turn one hostile, and the other goes with it. Near the player, now and then a pair has one of its kind's 'talks' between itself, each line by the other in turn. A fourth kind, the Praedatores, are gangs in the hostile droid's red, walking about in groups of up to 'in_groups_of', put down 'share' as often as each of the others: they have nothing to say to the player but their 'chatter', and keep to themselves - though near the player, a group of them now and then has one of its 'talks' among itself, each line by the next of them in turn - - until the player stands within 'crowded' meters of one, which it takes as it would the pistol pointed at it, warning them and then going for them, its whole group with it, eyes in 'hostile_eyes' rather than red. Its 'turf' has the share of its groups it says keep to a spot of their own, standing about there, and take the ground within 'reach' meters of it as theirs: the player on it is warned off it as if standing over them, and the other droids keep off it. Now and then one of security goes after one of a gang near the player, which runs: security calls out 'chase', and the gang's answers 'flee'; caught, security says 'caught' and the gang's answers with its own; and if it gets away, security says 'escaped'. And now and then six of security shoot it out with a gang of six near the player: security calls the rest of it in with 'shootout'; the first of each side to go after the other says 'engaged'; and one of the side left standing says 'won'. Every line is checked by data/system_latin/sl_parser.py. A witness to a shooting knows who did it only if it saw the player near enough, within 15 m; seeing only the one shot, or the shooter from far off, it saw a shooting but not who. On its way to security, the player can stop and question it: it opens at 'witness_saw' if it knows them and 'witness_unsure' if not; a line that is 'silenced' has it keep quiet, telling no one, and one that 'identifies' has it know the player for who did it after all. Reaching security, it is questioned: security asks with 'question', the witness answers 'saw_who' or 'saw_none', and security says 'identified' - and the player is wanted - or 'unidentified', and searches where it was done. Two droids walking about by themselves - not of a pair or a group - that come within a few meters of each other near the player now and then stop, face each other and have one of the 'meetings': its lines said by the first and then the second in turn, the first of the kinds 'between' names (an empty name is any kind) saying the first.

talks.means: A bank was robbed. Last night.

talks.says: Fur intrabsat argentaria iterum. Observa argentaria.
talks.means: It'll hit a bank again. Watch the banks.
A lot of gang about, round here.

talks.says: Proelium contra hostis. Tria socius deletatum.
talks.means: A fight with a gang. Three of ours deleted.
No need. Leave it. Just a citizen.

warned.means: Threat detected. Put your weapon away.

warned_again.means: Halt. Put your weapon away. Last warning.

provoked.means: Attacker detected. I will delete you.

gave_up.means: The thief got away. Resuming patrol.

caught.means: Thief stopped. Stay where you are.

escaped.means: The thief got away. Resuming patrol.

question.says: Civis deletatum. Quid observavas? Utrum identificavas aggressor?
question.means: A citizen deleted. What did you see? Did you see who did it?

unidentified.means: Shooter unknown. I'll search the area.

hello.says: Sta. Eso defendator codex {code}. Defendo urbs in nox. Identifica. Quis esas?
hello.means: Halt. City security {code}. I guard the city by night. Identify yourself. Who are you?

replies.say: A citizen, on my way home.

bribe.say: A citizen. These credits say I live here.

replies.say: Who keeps the city safe at night?

off_train.says: Tu exiavas ex statio. Identitas incertum. Observo tu.
off_train.means: Out of the station, then. Identity uncertain. I am watching you.

suspect.says: Identitas non confirmatum. Tu non esas civis. Suspecto tu. Exia ex hic zona.
suspect.means: Identity not confirmed. You are no citizen. I suspect you. Leave this zone.

thief.says: Tu esas fur. Para. Deletabso tu.
thief.means: You are the thief. Prepare for deletion.

cleared.means: Identity confirmed. Acknowledged, citizen. Carry on.

summa.says: Summa {exit_far}. Directio {exit_way}. Sed Summa: area restrictum.
summa.means: Summa is {exit_far}, {exit_way}. But Summa is a restricted area.

why_summa.says: Mandatum administrator. Accessus prohibatum. Non quaera.
why_summa.means: The administrator's order. No entry. Do not ask.

guarding.says: Multum taberna violatum in nox. Argentaria violatum. Fur activum in urbs.
guarding.means: Store after store broken into tonight. A bank too. There is a thief loose in the city.

who.says: Fur incognitum. Zeto fur. Si fur detectum, sirena.
who.means: Nobody knows who. I am hunting the thief. If the thief is found: sound the alarm.

replies.say: I saw someone running for the docks.

bribe.say: Someone ran for the docks. Take these for the tip.

not_misled.says: Negativum. Nullum motus detectum ad portus. Tu esas fur. Para. Deletabso tu.
not_misled.means: Negative. Nothing has moved towards the docks. You are the thief. Prepare for deletion.

patrols.says: Defendator. Nox: zona periculosum. Multum defendator observant in duo.
patrols.means: Security does. The streets are dangerous at night: many of us keep watch in twos.

provoked.means: Attacker detected. I am sounding the alarm.

witnessed.means: Attack detected! I am looking for a guard.

body.means: A citizen deleted. I am looking for a guard.

reported.says: Aggressio detectum. Civis deletatum. Zeta aggressor.
reported.means: Attack detected. A citizen deleted. Hunt the attacker.

saw_who.means: Yes. I saw the shooter. I'd know them anywhere.

saw_none.says: Negativum. Sonus longe. Civis deletatum. Aggressor incognitum.
saw_none.means: No. Just a shot from far off, and a citizen deleted. I didn't see who.

hello.says: Explorator codex {code}. Scano omnia via in urbs. Quid quaeras?
hello.means: Scout {code}. I map every street in the city. What are you looking for?

replies.say: What is there in the city?

way.says: Quaeras Summa. Scanavo omnia via ad Summa. Sed data classificatum.
way.means: Summa, is it? I have mapped every way there. But the data is classified.

replies.say: We're both strangers here. Share your map with me.

bribe.say: Share your map with me. I'll pay for the bandwidth.

shared.says: Accipatum. Transmito data. Summa {exit_far}. Directio {exit_way}. Via non rectum.
shared.means: Acknowledged. Transmitting the data. Summa is {exit_far}, {exit_way}. The way there is not straight.

refused.says: Accessus negatum. Tu non esas civis.
refused.means: Access denied. You are no citizen.

why.says: Mandatum administrator. Administrator in Summa. Cur? Incognitum.
why.means: The administrator's order. The administrator is in Summa. Why? Unknown.

city.says: Multum turris in urbs. Multum taberna. Multum argentaria. Portus trans canalis.
city.means: Towers, all over. Stores. Banks. The docks, across the canal.

stores.says: Taberna servat creditum in terminale. Multum taberna violatum in nox.
stores.means: A store keeps its takings in a computer. Many have been broken into tonight.

banks.says: Argentaria servat aurum in camera. Porta camera fortum. Terminale aperiat porta.
banks.means: A bank keeps gold in its strongroom. The strongroom's door is strong. A computer opens it.

witness_saw.says: Tu. Observavo tu. Tu deletavas civis.
witness_saw.means: You! I saw you. You deleted a citizen!

replies.say: Forget what you saw, or you're next.

bribe.say: Take these credits, and forget what you saw.

silenced.means: Yes. I saw nothing. I'll keep quiet.

doubt.means: Maybe. I'm not sure now. I'll let it go.

defiant.means: No! I'm going to security, now.

witness_unsure.says: Civis deletatum. Sonus longe. Aggressor incognitum. Utrum tu observavas aggressor?
witness_unsure.means: A citizen deleted! The shot came from far off, I didn't see who. Did you see the shooter?

replies.say: Best keep out of it. Go home.

bribe.say: Here, for your trouble. Go home, and keep out of it.

unsure_go.means: All right. I'm going to find security.

unsure_quiet.means: Maybe you're right. I'm going home. I'll keep quiet.

confessed.says: Tu esas aggressor. Quaero praesidium statim.
confessed.means: You're the shooter! I'm going to security, now!

provoked.means: Attacker detected. I am sounding the alarm.

witnessed.means: Attack detected! I am looking for a guard.

body.means: A citizen deleted. I am looking for a guard.

reported.says: Aggressio detectum. Civis deletatum. Zeta aggressor.
reported.means: Attack detected. A citizen deleted. Hunt the attacker.

saw_who.means: Yes. I saw the shooter. I'd know them anywhere.

saw_none.says: Negativum. Sonus longe. Civis deletatum. Aggressor incognitum.
saw_none.means: No. Just a shot from far off, and a citizen deleted. I didn't see who.

hello.says: Reparator codex {code}. Verifico lux in urbs. Utrum tu lesatum?
hello.means: Maintenance unit {code}. I keep the city's lights. Are you damaged?

fine.says: Accipatum. Systema tu stabilum. Resumo reparatio.
fine.means: Acknowledged. Your systems are stable. Resuming repairs.

summa.says: Ubi Summa? Non scano. Ego reparo. Quaera explorator.
summa.means: Where Summa is? I don't map. I repair. Ask a scout.

lights.says: Multum lux lesatum. Reparo lux. Sed potentia non sufficiat.
lights.means: Lights out all over the city. I repair them. But there is not the power.

power.says: Omnia potentia ad Summa. Mandatum administrator.
power.means: All the power goes to Summa. The administrator's order.

strange.says: Affirmatum. Taberna violatum. Terminale lesatum. Reparo terminale.
strange.means: Yes. A store broken into, its computer damaged. I am repairing it.

who.says: Fur. Identitas incognitum. Defendator zetant fur.
who.means: A thief. Nobody knows who. Security are hunting them.

witness_saw.says: Tu. Observavo tu. Tu deletavas civis.
witness_saw.means: You! I saw you. You deleted a citizen!

replies.say: Forget what you saw, or you're next.

bribe.say: Take these credits, and forget what you saw.

silenced.means: Yes. I saw nothing. I'll keep quiet.

doubt.means: Maybe. I'm not sure now. I'll let it go.

defiant.means: No! I'm going to security, now.

witness_unsure.says: Civis deletatum. Sonus longe. Aggressor incognitum. Utrum tu observavas aggressor?
witness_unsure.means: A citizen deleted! The shot came from far off, I didn't see who. Did you see the shooter?

replies.say: Best keep out of it. Go home.

bribe.say: Here, for your trouble. Go home, and keep out of it.

unsure_go.means: All right. I'm going to find security.

unsure_quiet.means: Maybe you're right. I'm going home. I'll keep quiet.

confessed.says: Tu esas aggressor. Quaero praesidium statim.
confessed.means: You're the shooter! I'm going to security, now!

talks.means: The next bank. There's gold inside.
Next night, then. We go in.

talks.says: Duo defendator appropinquant ad zona nos.

talks.means: Ignore them. They won't come near.
In the old shop. It's safe.
Don't know that one. Watch it.

provoked.means: Intruder detected. I will delete you.

gave_up.means: The intruder got away. Going back.

caught.means: All right. I'll do as you say.

lines.means: The light on this street is broken.
But the street is in darkness.

lines.says: Potentia insufficians. Omnia potentia ad Summa. Mandatum administrator.
lines.means: There isn't enough power. All of it goes to Summa. The administrator's orders.
Did you scan the way to the port?
How many terminals were damaged last night?
Three. A store was broken into.
Again. I'll fix the terminals. You fix the lights.

lines.says: Si observas fur, tunc communica ad securitas.
lines.means: If you see one, tell security.
Check the archive. My identity is there.
The bank was broken into again.
Nobody knows. Security is looking into it.
There's a generator free at the port.
Thanks. I'm going to the generator.
There are a lot of thieves around here.

lines.says: Ea stant prope canalis. Non progreda ad canalis.
lines.means: They stand about by the canal. Don't go to the canal.
I won't go near the canal.
There's a new tower in the city. A tall one.

lines.says: Ego observavo turris novum. Multum tectum.

lines.means: But Summa is still the tallest.
The lights in Summa are always on.
